title: Reoccurring dream in layered cabin type structure on a lake
content: I have a number of reoccurring dream scenarios and locations that have almost all been mentioned already in this sub (the mall, airport, warehouse etc) which I just found and am fascinated by. But there is one that I have been very familiar with recently where I am in 4 or 5 story cabin on a huge lake. It is layered almost like mall world, with balconies on every level that wrap around the whole building which is just square from what I can tell. I feel like there’s ropes and ladders and weird ways to sneak around and stuff and hide. Sometimes I find myself in the water and there can be huge fish but also regular ones. Anyone else have anything similar?
